entries.text: For crying out loud. All you're going to do is get yourself killed.
entries.speaker: Melvin Frohike

entries.text: Mulder! What are you doing?
entries.speaker: Dana Scully

entries.text: I'll be right with you, Scully.
entries.speaker: Fox Mulder

entries.text: What are they?
entries.speaker: Dana Scully

entries.text: Pueblos. Anasazi indian. Abandoned 2,000 years ago. Nobody knows why.
entries.speaker: Fox Mulder

entries.text: Yeah, Mulder, but what are we doing here?
entries.speaker: Dana Scully

entries.text: Hello. My name is Fox Mulder. Do you understand me?
entries.speaker: Fox Mulder

entries.text: Mulder, what is this?
entries.speaker: Dana Scully

entries.text: I was sent a message and a key to the government facility at mount weather. The indians said it was from a wise man who lived in the ruins. A keeper of the truth.
entries.speaker: Fox Mulder

entries.text: [ helicopter rotors whirring ]
entries.speaker: Sound

entries.text: Do you see anything at all?
entries.speaker: Monica Reyes

entries.text: What's the matter, agent Mulder? You come to see the wise man but you look as if you've seen a ghost.
entries.speaker: Cigarette-Smoking Man

entries.text: You're no wise man. You're a dead man. Just like Krycek and x.
entries.speaker: Fox Mulder

entries.text: You see a dead man, agent Scully?
entries.speaker: Cigarette-Smoking Man

entries.text: I hoped and prayed you were dead you chain-smoking son of a bitch.
entries.speaker: Dana Scully

entries.text: You waste your time. Ask Mulder. He knows the futility of hopes and prayers. He knows the truth now. You have told her the truth haven't you, Fox? I helped you find it.
entries.speaker: Cigarette-Smoking Man

entries.text: You didn't help me. You sent me to that government facility knowing exactly what I'd find.
entries.speaker: Fox Mulder

entries.text: And now you refuse to speak it. Not to Scully, not to anyone. You've even refused to testify what you learned... Even though it would have saved your life. You damned me for my secrets... But you're afraid to speak the truth.
entries.speaker: Cigarette-Smoking Man

entries.text: You call me afraid? Look at you sitting here alone in the dark like a fossil.
entries.speaker: Fox Mulder

entries.text: [ exhales ]
entries.speaker: Sound

entries.text: It's the final refuge. The last place to hide from those who are insidiously taking power now.
entries.speaker: Cigarette-Smoking Man

entries.text: Who?
entries.speaker: Dana Scully

entries.text: The aliens. They fear this place... Its geology. Magnetite. Like that which brought down the original UFO in Roswell. Indian wise men realized this over 2,000 years ago. They hid here. And watched their own culture die. The original shadow government.
entries.speaker: Cigarette-Smoking Man

entries.text: [ helicopter approaching ]
entries.speaker: Sound

entries.text: Agent Doggett!
entries.speaker: Monica Reyes

entries.text: Who the hell's that?
entries.speaker: John Doggett

entries.text: It leaves me to tell you what Mulder's afraid to, agent Scully.
entries.speaker: Cigarette-Smoking Man

entries.text: Come on, let's go.
entries.speaker: Fox Mulder

entries.text: It's a scary story. You want to come sit on my lap?
entries.speaker: Cigarette-Smoking Man

entries.text: You don't scare me.
entries.speaker: Dana Scully

entries.text: My story's scared every president since truman in '47.
entries.speaker: Cigarette-Smoking Man

entries.text: You don't have to hear this.
entries.speaker: Fox Mulder

entries.text: No, I want to hear it, Mulder.
entries.speaker: Dana Scully

entries.text: Ten centuries ago the mayans were so afraid that their calendar stopped on the exact date that my story begins. December 22, the year 2012. The date of the final alien invasion. Mulder can confirm the date. He saw it at mount weather......where our own secret government will be hiding when it all comes down.
entries.speaker: Cigarette-Smoking Man

entries.text: [ chuckles ]
entries.speaker: Sound

entries.text: Yeah, you smile... Feeling drunk with power. The power to do nothing.
entries.speaker: Fox Mulder

entries.text: My power comes from telling you. Seeing your powerlessness hearing it. They wanted to kill you, Fox. I protected you all these years... Waiting for this moment... To see you broken. Afraid. Now you can die.
entries.speaker: Cigarette-Smoking Man

entries.text: Run, Monica. Get out of here.
entries.speaker: John Doggett

entries.text: No.
entries.speaker: Monica Reyes

entries.text: Knowle Rohrer, that's far enough.
entries.speaker: John Doggett

entries.text: Shoot me, agent Doggett if you think it'll make a difference this time.
entries.speaker: Knowle Rohrer

entries.text: Agent Doggett!
entries.speaker: Fox Mulder

entries.text: Mulder, get out of there!
entries.speaker: John Doggett

entries.text: They know where you are!
entries.speaker: Monica Reyes

entries.text: Get out of here!
entries.speaker: Fox Mulder

entries.text: Get in the car.
entries.speaker: John Doggett

entries.text: No! Go! Go!
entries.speaker: Fox Mulder

entries.text: [ helicopters approaching ]
entries.speaker: Sound

entries.text: [ screaming ]
entries.speaker: Sound

entries.text: What are you thinking? Mulder?
entries.speaker: Dana Scully

entries.text: I'm thinking... I'm a guilty man. I've failed in every respect. I deserve the harshest punishment for my crimes.
entries.speaker: Fox Mulder

entries.text: You don't believe that.
entries.speaker: Dana Scully

entries.text: [ sighs ]
entries.speaker: Sound

entries.text: I believe that I sat in a motel room like this with you when we first met and I tried to convince you of the truth. And in that respect, I succeeded, but... In every other way... I've failed.
entries.speaker: Fox Mulder

entries.text: You don't believe that, either.
entries.speaker: Dana Scully

entries.text: Mm. I've been chasing after monsters with a butterfly net. You heard the man-- the date's set. I can't change that.
entries.speaker: Fox Mulder

entries.text: You wouldn't tell me. Not because you were afraid or broken... But because you didn't want to accept defeat.
entries.speaker: Dana Scully

entries.text: Well, I was afraid of what knowing would do to you. I was afraid that it would crush your spirit.
entries.speaker: Fox Mulder

entries.text: Why would I accept defeat? Why would I accept it, if you won't? Mulder, you say that you've failed but you only fail if you give up. And I know you-- you can't give up. It's what I saw in you when we first met. It's what made me follow you... Why I'd do it all over again.
entries.speaker: Dana Scully

entries.text: And look what it's gotten you.
entries.speaker: Fox Mulder

entries.text: And what has it gotten you? Not your sister. Nothing that you've set out for. But you won't give up, even now. You've always said that you want to believe. But believe in what, Mulder? If this is the truth that you've been looking for then what is left to believe in?
entries.speaker: Dana Scully

entries.text: I want to believe that the dead are not lost to us. That they speak to us as part of something greater than us-- greater than any alien force. And if you and I are powerless now I want to believe that if we listen to what's speaking it can give us the power to save ourselves.
entries.speaker: Fox Mulder

entries.text: Then we believe the same thing.
entries.speaker: Dana Scully

entries.text: Maybe there's hope.
entries.speaker: Fox Mulder
